target: macOS 27.3 (26C5035r), native on Xiaomi Pad 5 nabu
blocking_gaps: The macOS 27.3 IPSW contains XNU 13432.60.57; the available UniXNU macOS profile uses XNU 12377.121.6.
UniXNU documents macOS 27 arm64e as requiring native PAC hardware; this tablet reports no PAC fields and traps PACIA on all eight cores.
A separate public nabu port boots an iPadOS 17.7.11-based XNU userland on a modified 12 GiB unit; it is not a macOS 27.3 build, and its display provider is still missing.
The exact macOS 27.3 static kernelcache rewrite still refuses: 643 relocations, 24 unsupported PAC forms, and four uncovered executable segments.
Touch input and QCA6390 Wi-Fi have not been validated with the macOS 27.3 kernel ABI.
next_engineering_gate: Resolve the arm64e/native-PAC incompatibility and exact XNU 13432 source/build path, then forward-port and qualify nabu hardware drivers against macOS 27.3 before any install attempt.

related_nabu_port.reported_state: XNU reaches userland; SpringBoard and system daemons run, while an IOMobileFramebuffer provider is still missing.
related_nabu_port.hardware_difference: The maintainer reports an upgraded 12 GiB unit; the connected target reports MemTotal 5633852 kB.
related_nabu_port.relevance: Useful nabu boot and driver reference, but not evidence of macOS 27.3 on this 6 GiB-class tablet.
